judge.en: Someone is given a position of responsibility, like being a politician or a judge.
judge.zh: 某人被赋予了一定的职责，比如担任政客或法官。

judge.en: If someone feels judged, then they're worried about what other people think about them.
judge.zh: 如果有人觉得被评判，那他们就会担心别人怎么看他们。

judge.en: Young people are also worried about how people will appraise them, which means judge them.
judge.zh: 年轻人还担心别人会如何评估（appraise）他们，也就是评判他们。

judge.en: People are more worried now, younger people, about how other people are judging them.
judge.zh: 现在的年轻人更加担心别人会怎样评判自己。

judge.en: His mother was a hotel maid, and his father a cook working for a Belgian judge.
judge.zh: 他的母亲是一名酒店女佣，父亲是为比利时法官工作的厨师。

justify.en: The Declaration explained why the colonies believed separation from Britain was justified.
justify.zh: 《宣言》解释了为什么殖民地认为与英国分离是正当的。

justify.en: Certainly, avocado oil is good for all the reasons mentioned, but is it worth justifying the cost?
justify.zh: 当然，牛油果油有提到的种种好处，但它值得这个成本吗？

justify.en: It says that if you’ve acted in a certain way, over time, you’re going to overly justify your behavior.
justify.zh: 意思是如果你以某种方式行事，随着时间的推移，你会过度地为主张自己的行为寻找合理的解释。

justify.en: There's no greater waste of time than justifying your actions to people who have a life you don't want.
justify.zh: 没有什么比向那些过着你不想要的生活的人证明你的行为更浪费时间的了。

justify.en: What do you think, Nita? What might justify the price tag?
justify.zh: 你怎么看，Nita？是什么证明了这个价格的合理性？

junk.en: But look closely and you'll see children using the junk to play, building dens and hidey-holes.
junk.zh: 但仔细看，你会看到孩子们用这些垃圾玩耍，建造窝棚和藏身处。

junk.en: And these are junk science. These are low-power studies on very certain contexts that then get overapplied.
junk.zh: 而这些往往是垃圾科学。它们是在特定环境下进行的低效度研究，却被过度推广应用了。

junk.en: That's about pathogens. Junk DNA in bacteria and CRISPR was discovered because in bacteria, their DNA is evolved to fight viruses.
junk.zh: 这都是关于病原体的问题。细菌中的垃圾 DNA 和 CRISPR 的发现，是因为细菌的 DNA 进化出了对抗病毒的能力。

junk.en: Adventure playgrounds are indeed full of junk: pieces of construction material like old tyres, planks of wood and lengths of rope.
junk.zh: 冒险游乐场确实充满了垃圾：旧轮胎、木板和长绳子等建筑材料。

junk.en: Someone in goblin mode might be eating junk food in bed and ignoring all responsibilities, simply not caring about what anyone else thinks.
junk.zh: 处于“goblin mode”的人，可能会窝在床上吃垃圾食品，对一切责任都不闻不问，完全不在乎别人怎么想。

judgement.en: But broadly speaking, it’s a combination of data and editorial judgement.
judgement.zh: 但总体来说，这是数据分析和编辑判断相结合的结果。

judgement.en: Cromwell described it in a letter home as God's righteous judgement.
judgement.zh: Cromwell 在家信中将其描述为上帝的正义审判。

judgement.en: The lawful judgement of "his equals" — people like him.
judgement.zh: "同侪"的合法审判——也就是与他地位相当的人。

judgement.en: And how do you make that judgement when poverty is caused not only by unemployment, but by illness, old age, low wages, insecure work and high housing costs?
judgement.zh: 当贫困不仅由失业引起，还由疾病、年老、低工资、不稳定的工作和高昂的住房成本引起时，你又该如何做出这种判断？

judgement.en: It contains a clause that has shaped the law ever since: "No free man shall be seized, imprisoned, or dispossessed, except by the lawful judgement of his equals."
judgement.zh: 其中有一条条款，自此深刻塑造了后世的法律："任何自由人，非经其同侪的合法审判，不得被拘捕、监禁或剥夺财产。"

justice.en: The then Justice Secretary was furious. And so were many members of the public.
justice.zh: 当时的司法大臣勃然大怒，许多公众成员也同样如此。

justice.en: Indigenous communities continue to seek justice for the horrific and historic abuses they suffered.
justice.zh: 原住民社群仍在为他们所遭受的可怕历史虐待寻求正义。

justice.en: Nobody would see justice, at least publicly, for whatever happened to Otto Warmbier.
justice.zh: 无论奥托·瓦姆比尔身上到底发生过什么，至少在公开层面上，没有人会为此讨回公道了。

justice.en: This introduced cooperation across more areas: foreign policy, justice, and home affairs.
justice.zh: 这引入了更多领域的合作：外交政策、司法和内政。

justice.en: Then there’s the European Court of Justice, which ensures that EU law is interpreted and applied consistently.
justice.zh: 然后是欧洲法院，它确保欧盟法律得到一致的解释和应用。

jungle.en: These societies created trade networks, bringing together coastal, highland and jungle communities.
jungle.zh: 这些社会建立了贸易网络，将沿海、高原和丛林社区连接在一起。

jungle.en: He built a huge palace in his ancestral home in northern Congo, which was dubbed “The Versailles of the Jungle”.
jungle.zh: 他在刚果北部的祖籍地建造了一座巨大的宫殿，被称为“丛林凡尔赛”。

jungle.en: Fawcett took this as yet more evidence that the jungles and mountains of South America held secrets that were yet to be discovered.
jungle.zh: Fawcett 将此视为又一证据，证明南美洲的丛林和山脉隐藏着尚未被发现的秘密。

jungle.en: They are pretty small, roughly the size of London, and have this volcanic landscape: steep peaks, dense jungle, and black lava fields.
jungle.zh: 它们面积相当小，大致和伦敦差不多大，拥有火山地貌：陡峭的山峰、茂密的丛林和黑色的熔岩平原。

jungle.en: They set off in 1925, going up rivers, cutting through dense jungle, and negotiating passage with tribes that had rarely, if ever— encountered outsiders.
jungle.zh: 他们在 1925 年出发，逆流而上，劈开密林，并与那些极少——甚至从未——接触过外来者的部落进行交涉。

justification.en: And realizing that it's a justification for eating frogs earlier in the day.
justification.zh: 并且意识到这只是你在白天拖延、逃避困难任务的借口。

justification.en: Is this a justification for detachment, cultivated ignorance, distraction?
justification.zh: 这是为超脱、刻意无知或逃避现实找借口吗？

justification.en: I think the main justification is always safety, both in public spaces and safety at specific locations where people gather.
justification.zh: 我认为主要的理由永远是安全，无论是在公共空间还是人们聚集的特定地点的安全。

justification.en: He is older, and he has started to believe, perhaps with some justification, that he has built enough of a constituency to govern without Denard at his side.
justification.zh: 他年事渐高，并且开始相信（也许不无道理）自己已经建立了足够的支持基础，不再需要 Bob Denard 留在身边也能施政了。

justification.en: These bombings, which the government blamed on Chechen rebels, provided the justification for Putin’s launch of the Second Chechen War, a brutal military campaign to bring the region back under Russian control.
justification.zh: 政府将这些爆炸案归咎于车臣叛军，这为普京发动第二次车臣战争提供了借口，这是一场旨在将该地区重新置于俄罗斯控制之下的残酷军事行动。

jury.en: The first dates from 1670, when the principle of jury nullification was established in England.
jury.zh: 第一个案例要追溯到1670年，那一年，"陪审团废止权"这项原则在英格兰被正式确立。

jury.en: So, is it really? Where does the idea of jury service come from?
jury.zh: 那么，事实真是如此吗？陪审团服务这个概念究竟从何而来？

jury.en: Um, but I would know. And if I, if I believe what I say I do, which is that I'm the ultimate judge, jury and executioner of my own self-esteem, then I'm the only person who can say good job or not.
jury.zh: 但我自己心里清楚。如果我相信我所说的，即我是自己自尊心的最终法官、陪审团和执行者，那么我是唯一能评价我做得好不好的人。

junior.en: Humphries, even before he quit for good, started back in school, at a junior college in Texas.
junior.zh: 汉弗莱斯甚至在彻底放弃之前，就已经在德克萨斯州的一所两年制专科学校重新开始上学了。

junior.en: But some time in the late 1960s he had started an affair with his secretary, a woman 21 years his junior.
junior.zh: 但在 20 世纪 60 年代末的某个时候，他开始与比他小 21 岁的秘书发生婚外情。

junior.en: They were learning English so at the end of the year they could pass the junior high school exams and get into high school.
junior.zh: 他们学英语是为了在年底通过初中考试并考入高中。

junior.en: He was simply a junior intelligence officer, working behind the scenes in Cairo, reading reports, interrogating prisoners, and trying to make sense of the complex tribal and political landscape of the region.
junior.zh: 他只是开罗的一名初级情报官员，在幕后工作，阅读报告、审讯囚犯，并试图理清该地区复杂的部落和政治格局。

junior.en: These are different things. I used to work in Japanese junior high schools and elementary schools, and I can confidently say that none of the classes I worked in were learning English for the ability to use English in real life.
junior.zh: 这是两码事。我过去曾在日本的初中和小学工作过，我可以自信地说，我工作过的班级没有一个是在为了在现实生活中使用英语的能力而学习英语。
